newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end higher, CBOT corn also up.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end higher, CBOT corn also up.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended higher across the board on Monday, reflecting strong sentiment in CBOT corn futures, traders said.
Prices were 90 to 220 yen higher, with the benchmark September 1997 contract up 220 yen at 18,260 yen per tonne. The daily volume was 39,924 lots.

Light buying from individual investors supported all months from the opening, the traders said. Buying accelerated in the afternoon, helped by gains in CBOT overnight corn futures trading, they said. "Some traders had arbitrage between the CBOT and Tokyo markets," a trader said.
The spot September contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.67-3/4 per bushel at 0750 GMT against $3.65-1/2 at Friday's close.
The September contract on the CBOT soybean project A trading system was being traded at $8.07-1/2 at the same time, against $8.03-1/4 at Friday's close.
